en: Changed `/claude-api managed-agents-onboard` to give a new agent's built-in tools, and a quickstart template's MCP tools, the `auto` permission policy ("Judge risky actions") by default, matching the Claude Console; say "run without asking" to opt out
zh: 变更：`/claude-api managed-agents-onboard` 现在默认给新 agent 的内置工具以及快速入门模板的 MCP 工具设置 `auto` 权限策略（“Judge risky actions”），与 Claude Console 一致；说“run without asking”可退出该策略
